title: The CR's own examples, chapter 2 (Parts of a Card)
blind: Written from the CR text, printed card text and rulings (the lookup skill) only. The engine's src/, tests and baselines were not read. Committed before the comparison for this batch existed.
defaults: Unless a case says otherwise: the Runner has the default 4 MU and no link, both identities are blank, servers have no ice, the Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5, zones not mentioned hold only cards with no relevant abilities, and the Corp declines to rez or use anything not listed in the steps.

cases.position: Runner's turn. A rezzed Lycan with 1 advancement counter is the only ice protecting HQ. Tinkering is in the grip.

steps.label: tinker
steps.do: The Runner plays Tinkering, choosing Lycan.

expect.why: One printed instance, one removed by Lycan's own ability (odd number of advancement counters).
Two instances (printed and Tinkering), one removal: the total is above zero.
Tinkering lasts until the end of the turn.
